newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares close lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares close lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Sustained profit-taking in several heavyweight stocks pushed the Jakarta index below the psychological barrier of 700 points on Tuesday, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index closed 6.55 points lower, or 0.93 percent down, at 695.22 points after touching a daily high of 703.11 points a few minutes after it opened.
Losers led gainers by 77 to 40, with 55 counters unchanged.
"I think the market is in a testing period around the record area of 700-points," analyst with Singapore-based firm said.
